notes: New: the meter now reads your Genus collection, pets and wings and attaches them to your aion2t.com profile alongside your fight uploads. Fixes: a phantom extra party member — an outside player attacking the same boss could show up as an extra row and be saved into your fight history, so party membership now requires positive proof instead of assuming anyone hitting your target is in your group; party members who join late are no longer dropped while the roster catches up; window size is now remembered when you resize with Settings, History or Details open; your character is identified at the start of a fight instead of the end and no longer swaps with a party member mid-fight; wiping on a boss starts a fresh attempt instead of merging into the previous pull.
